overview: The project team presented six design alternatives for the Medford High School building project, ranging from code upgrades to total new construction, ahead of a final selection deadline. Discussion focused on construction phasing, cost escalations, and the prioritization of athletic field space.

items.title: Project Timeline and MSBA Submission
items.summary: The committee announced it will select a single design option on June 10th for submission to the MSBA no later than June 25th.

items.title: Design Alternatives Review
items.summary: Matt Rice outlined six design options currently under consideration, including code upgrades, extensive renovations, and a new 'high school only' variation of the C2.2a concept.

items.title: Construction Phasing and Schedule
items.summary: The team explained that an estimated 80-month construction period would utilize phased completions to allow building occupancy significantly sooner than the final project end date.

items.title: Project Costs and Site Planning
items.summary: Presenters addressed a 4% annual cost escalation and discussed prioritizing athletic space by potentially constructing a field on top of a parking garage.
